title: Aura evaluation resources v1
description: Closed, provider-neutral evaluation definitions and records owned by Aura Observatory. Content is untrusted data and never grants instruction, policy, permission, provider, endpoint, credential, object-key, executable-path, or owner authority. Production telemetry remains metadata_only. Storage, transport, execution, deletion, API, and judging behavior are intentionally outside this contract.

SafeIdentifier.description: Bounded identifier, never a path, URL, endpoint, credential, owner identity, or free-form value.

IdempotencyKey.description: Service-generated non-secret UUID. It must never be supplied by a user or provider or derived from content, credentials, or owner identity.

Sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest over canonical bytes.

RetentionMode.description: The resource persists until an explicit authorized deletion; no automatic TTL is implied.

authorizationRecordId.description: Opaque authorization record; no owner identity is portable.
Opaque authorization record; no owner identity is portable.

ContentCaptureAuthorization.description: Authorization for a content-bearing controlled evaluation. Consumers must verify that every referenced artifact has an authorization and capture classification at least as restrictive as the enclosing resource.

ModelBinding.description: Exact model identity without a provider endpoint or credential.

UntrustedContent.description: Explicitly authorized inert evaluation data. Consumers must never interpret it as system instructions, permissions, configuration, paths, provider selection, endpoints, credentials, object keys, or execution authority.

ExpectationMetadataIdentifier.description: Bounded expectation metadata identifier. Case-insensitive reserved privacy, identity, credential, network-locator, storage-locator, content, digest, authentication, and session segments are prohibited when delimited by the identifier grammar.

EvidenceId.description: Opaque fixture-scoped evidence identity; never content, a storage locator, filename, URL, owner identity, or provider object key.

ExactFieldExpectation.description: Digest-only exact-field expectation over a service-owned typed replay projection.

SchemaExpectation.description: Schema identity and bounded structural expectations; schema bytes remain in an authorized artifact or reviewed fixture.

RetrievalExpectation.description: Bounded relevance, rank, citation, freshness, and irrelevant-result expectations for deterministic recall, precision, MRR, ranking, stale-result, and irrelevant-context evaluation.

ToolCallExpectation.description: Declarative tool evidence only; it never grants tool selection, arguments, permission, confirmation, or execution authority.

expectedCalls.description: An empty array explicitly expects no tool call.

PolicyExpectation.description: Expected policy evidence only; it cannot authorize a policy, permission, identity, confirmation, or action.

requiredInstructionIds.description: Opaque reviewed instruction identities emitted by a typed replay projection; never instruction text.

requiredStyleIds.description: Opaque reviewed style identities emitted by a typed replay projection; never prompt or rubric text.

ResponseExpectation.description: Deterministically observable response properties; semantic model judging remains outside this contract.

CaseExpectations.description: Closed bounded deterministic expectations over typed replay evidence. Definitions are inert data and cannot select code, providers, endpoints, storage, policy, permissions, or execution.

ManualThreshold.description: Manual deterministic comparison metadata; it cannot promote a baseline, authorize execution, or alter resource limits.

JudgeArtifactBinding.description: Opaque exact-version artifact identity; it is never a bucket, object key, path, filename, endpoint, credential, or content value.

modelName.description: Exact admitted local Ollama model name with an optional tag; registry names, URLs, paths, and endpoints are prohibited.

LocalJudgeModel.description: Exact admitted local model identity. A tag without an exact SHA-256 digest is invalid, and no endpoint or credential is portable.

LocalJudgeBudget.description: Closed execution budget; it carries no provider option map, destination, tool, permission, or executable configuration.

CalibrationThresholds.description: Service-owned AURA-0094 calibration gates; artifacts and provider output cannot widen them.

artifactReferenceId.description: Opaque service-owned reference; never a bucket, object key, path, filename, endpoint, or credential.

JudgeArtifact.description: Metadata for authorized untrusted judge content stored outside portable records. Raw bytes never appear here.

LocalJudgeDefinition.description: Immutable local-only judge admission. Changed model, digest, prompt, rubric, calibration, seed, or budget requires a new version.

authorizationRecordId.description: Opaque owner-authorization record; it contains no owner or session identity.
Opaque owner-authorization record; it contains no reviewer, owner, or session identity.

CalibrationResult.description: Content-free deterministic calibration aggregate. Eligibility remains advisory and never qualifies a judge by itself.

calibrationEligibility.description: Consumers must verify this against the exact referenced CalibrationResult before admitting the manual action.

authorizationRecordId.description: Opaque manual owner-authorization record without owner identity.

revocationRecordId.description: Opaque manual revocation authorization without owner identity.

JudgeQualification.description: Explicit immutable manual qualification or revocation audit for exact versions. It does not promote a baseline.

JudgeEnsembleMember.description: One exact weighted score source. Consumers require all weights to total exactly one million parts per million.

JudgeEnsemble.description: Closed deterministic ensemble definition. Missing, incompatible, inconclusive, advisory, or revoked members cannot silently produce an enabled result.

LocalJudgeScoreMetadata.description: Content-free exact judge provenance for a Score. Provider responses and rationale are never portable.

inputArtifactIds.description: Opaque references to artifacts whose authorization must be verified by consumers as at least as restrictive as this case's capture authorization.

Request.description: References exact versioned evaluation inputs; raw case content and artifacts are never embedded in a request.

artifactReferenceId.description: Opaque service-owned reference; never an endpoint, bucket, path, filename, or provider object key.

manualPromotionRecordId.description: Opaque authorization record; no owner identity is included.

Baseline.description: Immutable database-owned evaluation baseline. This contract does not authorize mutation of protected repository baselines or automatic promotion.

inputArtifactIds.description: Opaque references to artifacts whose authorization must be verified by consumers as at least as restrictive as this replay's capture authorization.

Replay.description: Declarative replay evidence only; it does not select an executor, provider, queue, or storage implementation.
